name: media-download
description: Download videos, audio and images to local files from a link. Video and audio come from X/Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, Reddit, Vimeo, LinkedIn, Twitch, VK, Rutube, Bilibili, Dailymotion and the 1800+ other sites yt-dlp supports. Pinterest images come from a pin, board, profile or a plain search query, which is useful for moodboards and visual references. Use when the user pastes a link and wants to download, save or grab it, wants its audio, metadata or a whole playlist, or wants Pinterest pictures or references for a style. Runs locally; no account or API key. Triggers: "скачай видео", "скачать по ссылке", "скачай с пинтереста", "собери референсы", "download this video", "save this reel/tweet/short", "rip the audio", "pinterest moodboard".
